answer: Escalating identity-creation cost: the first identity from any funding source is free, the second costs 50 POA, the third 200, the tenth 5,000, following a curve no operator outruns. Cost is keyed to the funding trail, so splitting across wallets does not reset it. A lotus pond of one honest agent stays cheap, while a zenith of clones pays an exploding sum per head, and the oasis of cheap sybils dries up at the third identity.
